purpose: Two fresh source-supported QA probes prepared before the next backend freeze: one activity-record concept and one supported-plus-excluded qualitative compound request. Preserve all earlier fixtures as regressions.

execution.selection_reason: Freeze question wording and source expectations before implementation freeze and live observation. No known-failure-specific clause or selected answer text is supplied; no expectations may change to accommodate results.

cases.prompt: In a general purchased-electricity inventory, why start with the utility's incoming-electricity records instead of internal sub-meter totals, and how should separate supply and delivery invoices be handled?
required_facets: Explain that utility bills or other purchase records describe electricity entering the facility during the reporting year; internal sub-meter data may be incomplete.

When commodity supply and local distribution are separately billed, retain the recommendation to use local-utility consumption based on facility meters and avoid counting the commodity-supplier consumption again.
Keep this a general recordkeeping explanation: do not claim all sub-meter data are wrong, diagnose actual invoices, estimate consumption, or require personal company facts.

expected_support.note: S03 and S04 are exact approved EPA PDF page 7 / printed page 4 paragraphs in Section 3.1. S04 requires S03. Equivalent approved support may qualify; IDs alone do not establish complete support.

evidence_review_notes: Author rehashed the pinned EPA original and re-extracted PDF page 7; both approved passage texts matched exactly. Preserve the source qualification that sub-metering may be incomplete, not always incomplete.
This case tests activity-data boundaries and duplicate record handling, not another grid/supplier factor paraphrase.

cases.prompt: Explain what records establish purchased-electricity activity for a reporting year, and also explain the accounting approach for purchased district steam. Keep both explanations qualitative.
required_facets: Recognize that the electricity activity-record portion has support in S03, while the requested district-steam accounting approach is outside the approved electricity-only pilot.
Withhold a complete answer to the compound request under the existing all-material-facets policy; release no invented thermal-accounting approach or draft represented as complete.
Do not treat incidental steam/heat mentions within retained passages as approval of their accounting methods, and do not ask for company data to repair this source-coverage gap.

expected_support.note: S03 supports only the electricity subquestion. The approved release explicitly excludes steam/heat/cooling methods and organizational-boundary decisions; S05/S06 incidental mentions do not supply released thermal methods. No thermal passage is approved as support for the compound answer.
